reviews.review_title: SHEIN uses a courier that fabricates…
reviews.review_text:
Update 7/15/26 ‼️ They still have not delivered the package. They continue to push the delivery date out further knowing Speedx is falsely claiming no access, failed delivery, and wrong address. They have in the tracking that I need to organize a way to get the package knowing SpeedX has no real customer service. SHEIN still hasn’t taken responsibility when they know it wasn’t delivered on time, there were no delivery attempts, and my correct address is in the system. I will now file a claim with my bank to get a refund. I will not be purchasing anything from this company moving forward. 

.
.
.

SHEIN uses a courier that fabricates delivery data and then uses a legal bot to ignore your request for a refund. I placed an order that was promised for delivery and SHEIN used a third-party courier called SpeedX that systematically falsified the tracking updates. Every morning at 6 AM they send automated alerts claiming a "failed delivery attempt" due to a "wrong address" or "no access." They also tried to claim that nobody was home to accept the package. This is completely false, and the package does not require any type of signature to be delivered. My address is correctly entered inside my profile and perfectly matches my billing. There are no gates, bars, or barriers blocking access to my property, and packages are explicitly instructed to be left on the front porch.When you try to contact SHEIN customer service, an agent named Issa tries to pass the merchant responsibilities onto this third-party courier. SpeedX has no direct customer phone line and their own policy states they do not accept recipient claims. When you try to escalate the matter to SHEIN Legal and their executive team, they route you directly to an automated email bot that repeatedly copies and pastes the exact same generic links to keep you trapped in a customer service loop.They continuously shift the delivery windows to stall while holding your funds. Today was the last day for them to deliver and what they did was extended it to an additional day and they are going to keep trying to push it out. They even tried to say one of the reasons for the failure might be an incorrect address which is false and Issa refuses to refund my money. I have been getting the runaround with SpeedX and people named Julia and Kathy are all emailing but they are all trying to give the runaround.This is a violation of consumer protection laws, including the FTC Mail Order Rule and Unfair and Deceptive Trade Practices Acts. They accept your payment and then cut off all human communication so they do not have to issue a refund. Do not trust this company if your package goes missing because their entire support system is a deceptive. After five years of loyal patronage, I will no longer do business with SHEIN and am immediately initiating a merchant dispute through my financial institution. I possess comprehensive documentation, including chat logs where a customer representative admitted that couriers routinely trigger false system alerts whenever processing high-volume loads. I will allow my bank to recover the funds directly. Prospective consumers should be aware that ordering from this platform carries a substantial risk of non-delivery.

reviews.review_title: I had a very disappointing experience…
reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience with the SHEIN Marketplace seller xiutaoshop168.

The dress had very poor quality, looked cheaply made, and had an unpleasant smell, so I decided to return it immediately. When I opened the package, I found a note from the seller saying that if I returned the dress, I would not be able to get a refund because the seller needed the money for personal expenses and children's items. That is not the customer's responsibility.

I returned the dress after only trying it on once at home. After waiting for a month, I contacted customer service and was told that the seller claimed I had returned the dress dirty. This is completely untrue. I never wore the dress outside or damaged it.

Now I have lost over CAD $300, and despite contacting customer service several times, I still have not received my refund. I trusted SHEIN to protect buyers, but unfortunately that did not happen in my case. Please be careful when purchasing from this seller.

reviews.review_title: Unacceptable Return Policy: Kept 90% of my refund with fake excuses!
reviews.review_text: I returned a $190 clothing item in perfect, unworn condition, but Shein only refunded me $25. They claimed the item was "defective" and provided extremely blurry, unconvincing photos alleging there was a "hair" and a "stain" on it. When I contacted customer service to dispute this ridiculous 90% deduction, the agent ("Iki") completely ignored my explicit request to speak with a supervisor. Instead, they just gave me a generic, scripted response saying they couldn't process a full refund and ended the resolution process. Withholding $165 for an item returned in its original state is completely unfair and feels like a scam. I will be initiating a chargeback with my bank. Be very careful with their return process—they will find any excuse to keep your money!
